pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, predominantly sub-quadrangular and polygonal patches on the neck and upper flank with relatively sharp edge gradients. Patches on the lower flank display increased fragmentation and more irregular, curvilinear geometries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pelage. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness remains relatively uniform on the neck but exhibits high tortuosity and thinning between smaller patch clusters on the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck, characterized by short, dense mane hair spikes against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal birds (oxpeckers) on the animal's lateral surface; one bird on the mid-flank is sharply defined with a visible yellow and red beak, while two others are visible on the lower neck/shoulder transition.
